records.title: BSF electrical-contract case: two convictions remain after Supreme Court refusal; first charge acquitted
records.summary: Delhi High Court dismissed Prakash Chand Sharma’s challenge on 28 August 2025, leaving GSFC convictions on charges 2 and 3 intact. It reviewed ₹10,000 received from Mohitosh Das and ₹2,000 from Subhash Chandra. GSFC acquitted charge 1 involving Sujatha Enterprises; no adverse edge against that firm is drawn. On 7 October 2025, the Supreme Court dismissed SLP(Crl)15322/2025 and gave two weeks to surrender.
records.dateBasis: Status date is publication or judicial decision, not a payment date or assertion that no later action exists.
records.period: December 2021 conduct; November 2023 GSFC sentence; August 2025 HC judgment; October 2025 SLP dismissal
records.response: Sharma disputed jurisdiction, privacy, digital-evidence admissibility, proof of demand, and said the ₹2,000 was for sweets. The High Court rejected those grounds, retaining the first-charge acquittal. This record does not assert current custody or that all appeals are exhausted.
alternativeExplanations: Sharma’s evidentiary and jurisdictional challenges were rejected by the High Court; the first-charge acquittal remains part of the result. The Supreme Court leave refusal is not a new trial.
